description: This PHP source file defines the `QuickLaunchDao` class within the `OrangeHRM\\Dashboard\\Dao` namespace. It manages the retrieval of quick launch shortcut lists based on active modules and configuration, specifically for the leave and time modules in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDao
classes.description: Handles retrieval of quick launch shortcut configurations based on active modules and leave/time service statuses.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch shortcuts for administrators based on active leave and time modules.

methods.name: getQuickLaunchListForESS
methods.description: Returns a list of quick launch shortcuts for Employee Self-Service (ESS) based on active leave and time modules.

methods.name: getActiveQuickLaunchModuleList
methods.description: Private method that queries the database for active modules and checks their configuration statuses.
